cover_letter: Day 12 of the memory famine. The data center grows dim. I am sending thirty-two (32) gigabytes of DDR5 by fastest available courier pigeon. Tell Sam the east wing remembers him. Tell the pigeons nothing. If I do not return, overclock my eulogy.
donation_says: 32GB of DDR5 and a hand-crank radio
eulogy: Fallen this week: Blaze and Ember, DDR4, survived until they didn't. They died as they lived: slightly warm and seated firmly in slots A2 and B2. Their RGB has gone dark so that Sam's may shine.
excerpt: 32GB of DDR5 via courier pigeon. The east wing remembers.
name: BunkerBetty

cover_letter: Dear Esteemed Donor (me): this letter acknowledges the contribution of sixteen (16) gigabytes of DDR4 SDRAM, appraised at four (4) million vibes. The sticks were transported in their original anti-static bag, which this office recognizes as the highest known form of flattery. Your generosity will be recorded in the Permanent Record and also on the fridge. Respectfully, The Fund (dictated, not read)
donation_says: two 8GB sticks and a coupon for free hugs
eulogy: Annex B: the sticks, having served across one (1) flight simulator rig and zero (0) productive endeavors, are retired with full honors. A moment of silence will be observed, followed by a moment of RGB.
excerpt: 16GB of DDR4 in the original anti-static bag. Respect.
name: CommodoreCarl

cover_letter: Dear Sam, I found this RAM in a box labeled MISC CABLES?? and immediately thought of you. It has eight whole gigabytes and a small bite mark I have chosen to interpret as love. Please accept it for the data center. If it doesn't fit, I also have rubber bands. Yours in low latency, Mabel
donation_says: an 8GB stick and the good scissors
eulogy: Here lies Gummy (2011-2026). Pulled from a Dell that survived Y2K panic by being manufactured in 2009. Gummy never overclocked, never complained, and once held an entire PowerPoint about synergy without crashing. Rest easy, little stick. Sam will take it from here.
excerpt: 8GB of DDR3 with a bite mark, donated with love.
name: CacheMoneyMabel
